JARVIS v0.5.9

本次更新加入語音請求的錄音重播。請留意：由這個版本起，JARVIS 會預設保存你語音請求的錄音。

新功能
- 語音請求旁邊新增「播放錄音」，可以重聽自己當時說了甚麼。只適用於更新後錄下的語音請求，之前的請求沒有錄音。

錄音的保存方式
- 預設開啟，升級後亦然。如不想保存，可到「設定 > 語音」關閉「保存語音請求的錄音」；關閉時，已保存的錄音會一併刪除。
- 錄音只存於這部 Mac 的加密資料庫，不會上傳到 JARVIS，亦不會交給 AI 讀取。
- 清除對話時，當中的錄音會一併刪除；「設定 > 儲存空間」的保留期限清理舊對話時亦然。
- 以喚醒詞啟動時，如 JARVIS 誤以為你在呼叫它而又聽到說話，該段聲音（最長約 28 秒）會連同文字一併保存。
- 語音轉錄方式不變：使用雲端語音辨識時，語音仍會傳送至該服務轉錄。

連接 Google
- 首次連接 Google 只會要求日曆權限，以及你的名稱和電郵地址，不再要求 Gmail。
- 如要讓助手搜尋、閱讀、起草或封存郵件，可到「設定 > 助手 Google」選擇「連接 Gmail」，並選擇同一個 Google 帳戶。
- 已連接 Google 的用戶不受影響，毋須重新授權。

適用於 Apple Silicon Mac，App 要求 macOS 12 或以上。
notes_en:
JARVIS v0.5.9

This update lets you play your voice requests back. Please note: from this version, JARVIS keeps a recording of each voice request by default.

New
- A "Play recording" button next to each voice request lets you hear what you said. It works for voice requests made after this update; earlier requests have no recording.

How recordings are kept
- On by default, including after an upgrade. To stop, turn off "Keep recordings of my voice requests" in Settings > Speech; turning it off also deletes the recordings already kept.
- Recordings are stored only in the encrypted database on this Mac. They are not uploaded to JARVIS and the AI cannot read them.
- Clearing a conversation deletes its recordings, and so does the retention window in Settings > Storage when it removes old conversations.
- With the wake word, if JARVIS mistakes a sound for its name and then hears speech, that audio (up to about 28 seconds) is kept together with its text.
- Transcription is unchanged: when cloud speech recognition is in use, the audio is still sent to that service to be transcribed.

Connecting Google
- Connecting Google for the first time now asks only for Calendar access and your name and email address, not Gmail.
- To let the Assistant search, read, draft or archive mail, choose Connect Gmail in Settings > Assistant Google and pick the same Google account.
- If you have already connected Google, nothing changes and you do not need to sign in again.

For Apple Silicon Macs; the app requires macOS 12 or later.
